heroSummary: For 2027–28, K–12 students in Denver Public Schools start school Monday, August 23. Early Childhood Education students start Tuesday, August 24. The last day of school is Friday, June 2, with a half-day early release. Thanksgiving Break runs November 22–26, Winter Break runs December 20–January 3, and Spring Break runs March 27–31. These are districtwide dates from the DPS family and student calendar. Individual schools may publish additional dates for testing, conferences, athletics, transportation changes, bell schedules, and other school events.
calendarNotes: DPS’s 2027–28 family and student calendar combines vacation and staff-learning no-class dates under one label. It also marks other holidays and observances separately and notes that school is open on those observance dates unless the date is separately shown as no classes.

sourceReviewDetails: August 4, 2026 — All districtwide dates on this page were checked against the DPS calendar page and the official PDF created May 19, 2026.

We checked the K–12 first day, ECE first day, last day, instructional-day count, holidays/no classes, vacation or staff-learning/no-class dates, conference/no-class dates, post-student-year holidays, and major break ranges.
The DPS PDF lists 174.5 instructional days.
Because this is a future-year calendar, the page will be reviewed again if DPS replaces the PDF or revises its calendar page.

calendarFaqs.q: Do ECE students start on the same day as K–12 students?
calendarFaqs.a: No. K–12 students start Monday, August 23, 2027. Early Childhood Education students start Tuesday, August 24.

calendarFaqs.q: Is January 3 part of Winter Break?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. Winter Break runs through Monday, January 3, 2028. Students return Tuesday, January 4.

calendarFaqs.q: Does every DPS holiday or observance mean school is closed?
calendarFaqs.a: No. On the official DPS calendar, some dates are marked as holidays or observances even when school remains open. Look for a separate no-classes designation before assuming students are off.

calendarFaqs.q: Can the 2027–28 DPS calendar still change?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. DPS currently publishes this as its 2027–28 family and student calendar, but the district may revise future-year dates. Check the official calendar page before making final plans.

calendarFaqs.q: Does the downloaded DPS calendar update automatically?
calendarFaqs.a: The .ics file is a one-time import, not a live calendar subscription. Download a new copy if DPS publishes a revised calendar.

calendarFaqs.q: Does this calendar include school-specific events?
calendarFaqs.a: This page covers districtwide dates only. Individual schools may publish separate dates for testing, conferences, athletics, transportation changes, bell schedules, and same-day announcements.

customSections.content: The 2027–28 DPS calendar uses one marking for both vacation days and staff learning days when students do not have classes. It also uses separate markings for holidays, conferences, observances, first days, and the last day of school.
